description: The plot illustrates the similarity across different layers, comparing four distinct combinations represented by different colored lines. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 22 in intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45 in intervals of 0.05. The red line, representing "en&en", starts at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, peaks at around 0.28 at layer 6, decreases to about 0.17 at layer 8, remains relatively stable until layer 12, then gradually declines to around 0.11 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to 0.43 at layer 22. The blue line, representing "en&es", follows a similar trend, starting at around 0.04, peaking at 0.23 at layer 6, and ending at 0.35 at layer 22. The green line, representing "en&el", begins at approximately 0.03, peaks at around 0.13 at layer 6, and ends at 0.32 at layer 22. The purple line, representing "en&bn", starts at about 0.02, peaks at 0.11 at layer 6, and ends at 0.31 at layer 22. All lines exhibit a peak at layer 6, a decline until layer 20, and a sharp increase at layer 22.
